Looking at this question, I need to identify the cartoon adversary of Pixie and Dixie who famously said "I hate those meeces to pieces."

Pixie and Dixie were cartoon mice characters from the Hanna-Barbera animated series that appeared on "The Huckleberry Hound Show" in the late 1950s and early 1960s. Their antagonist was a cat who constantly chased them and was known for that specific catchphrase with the deliberate mispronunciation of "mice" as "meeces."

The other agents have provided answers of either "Jinks the Cat" or "Mr. Jinks" - these refer to the same character. The character's full name is "Mr. Jinks" (sometimes styled as "Mister Jinks"), though he's also referred to simply as "Jinks." All agents are essentially in agreement
